show.description: Chasing Gold is an intense sports drama about courage, sacrifice, and national pride. Once disgraced kickboxing champion Arvind, haunted by a doping scandal, is forced back into the ring when his fearless daughter Saanvi takes on a dangerous challenge against Pakistan’s top fighters. As generations clash and blood is spilled for honor, their battle becomes more than a fight—it’s a war for respect, identity, and the soul of a nation.
